about: Models used by the MaRTiny image server. The weights are not stored in this repository: see README.md in this folder. sha256 values are those of the files the SHaDE Lab runs, so you can check that your copy is the same.

models.name: YOLOv8x (people detection)
models.obtain: Downloaded automatically by the ultralytics package the first time MARTINY_DETECTOR=yolo runs.

models.name: BDRAR shadow detector, trained checkpoint (the file the lab runs as 3000.pth)
models.obtain: From the lab's private MaRTiny-server repository (Git LFS), or the trained model the BDRAR authors link in their README.
models.license: not stated by the BDRAR authors: confirm before you redistribute

models.name: ResNeXt-101 32x4d backbone used by BDRAR
models.obtain: From the lab's private MaRTiny-server repository (Git LFS), or the converted ResNeXt model the BDRAR authors link in their README.
models.license: not stated: confirm before you redistribute
